title: LLVM GVN invalid load elimination across volatile atomic store memory clobber
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0329: LLVM GVN invalid load elimination across volatile atomic store memory clobber
Repository: `llvm/llvm-project`
Category: `Compiler IR Optimization & SSA Lowering`
Target File: `lib/Transforms/Scalar/GVN.cpp`

#### Problem Description
Global Value Numbering hoists cached load value across atomic_store without checking memory ordering barrier.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Add MemoryLocation clobber check against atomic ordering semantics before eliminating load.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0329.py -q`
expected_invariant: Add MemoryLocation clobber check against atomic ordering semantics before eliminating load.
